page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a dedicated x86_64 server instance powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor featuring 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The system includes 128 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware acceleration flags include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI support, AES, FMA, ADX, and BMI2, complemented by a 35 MB L3 cache. Baseline network throughput is rated at 10 Gbps, while local disk storage is absent, requiring external network-attached block storage solutions.

Benchmark results place the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge in the middle performance tier across multiple compute and memory workloads. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 29,517.51 and a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 30,666.35. Memory bandwidth reaches 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 48.22 GB/sec for large block writes. In application-specific metrics, it processes 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. CPU-based LLM inference performance yields 45.98 prompt tokens per second and 12.4 text generation tokens per second using a 7B parameter model.

The ecs.hfg6.8xlarge offers solid mid-range resource density and balanced compute-to-memory proportions without the added cost of dedicated GPU accelerators. The lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network storage volumes, which introduces latency considerations for disk-bound IOPS operations. Its clock speed of 3.1 GHz combined with AVX-512 execution units provides efficient CPU-based vector calculations and multi-threaded processing. This resource profile makes the instance well suited for general-purpose application backends, web serving clusters, Redis caching layers, software compilation, and moderate ETL pipeline processing.
